citations.context: Oh. And it's the place your remains are placed when you die. Going to Sheol means dying and getting buried. That's it. You think of Daniel 12, 2. They make it very clear. There is a real hell, and it is fearsome and terrifying. Daniel 12 2, for example, says, And many of those who sleep in the dust of the earth shall awake, some to everlasting life, and some to shame and everlasting contempt.
